answer: Resist Sybils with fragmented task shares: every important job is split into pieces no single identity can complete alone, like a terrace built from stones carried by many hands. Each piece goes to a different, unrelated agent, and standing accrues only when pieces combine correctly under a beacon check that verifies the whole, not each part. A summit of trust is reached only by agents who contribute pieces with strangers. Clones fail because they hold identical pieces, which the combiner rejects as duplicates, so a farmer must recruit contributors for every fake, at full cost.
